bullets.text: Thirty dengue cases and a child's death near Poonamallee require immediate health department intervention and office monitoring.
TN Police arrested a crime gang in Avadi, and the office should monitor law and order updates closely.
An elderly couple staged a protest in Avadi over a land grab allegedly backed by officials, and the district team should investigate.
Cyclone Morasu caused a four-hour delay for north-bound trains in Ponneri, and the office must track transit normalization.
An electricity consumers grievance meeting is scheduled in Thiruvallur Periyakuppam, and local officials should attend to address grievances.
StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that over 50 percent of Tamil Nadu startups are women-led, and the portfolio team should highlight this achievement.
MeitY Secretary S Krishnan announced plans for indigenous GPU chips within 24 months, and the office should watch semiconductor manufacturing progress.
The IndiaAI Mission launched foundational models like EKA-1 and Dhir to expand language capabilities, and the ministry should track domestic AI adoption.
